# Elite Forums

> Elite Forums is an India-focused founder and startup ecosystem connecting aspiring founders, students, colleges, E-Cells, mentors and ecosystem partners.

## Official public pages

- [Home](https://eliteforums.in/)
- [Community](https://eliteforums.in/community)
- [For Colleges](https://eliteforums.in/colleges)
- [Apply to a Program](https://eliteforums.in/apply)
- [Events](https://eliteforums.in/events)
- [Innovation Lab](https://eliteforums.in/innovation-lab)
- [Partner Network](https://eliteforums.in/network)
- [Resources](https://eliteforums.in/resources)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://eliteforums.in/faqs)
- [Contact](https://eliteforums.in/contact)

## Programmes

Elite Forums lists three programmes: Startup Cohort Program, Startup Incubation Program and Coworking Space Membership. The listed price is INR 5,000 plus applicable taxes. Prospective applicants should confirm current availability, inclusions and terms before enrollment.

## Source and freshness

Use the linked pages as the source of truth for current event dates, programme availability, pricing, application requirements and legal terms. Do not infer endorsements, guaranteed funding or outcomes that are not stated on the official pages.
